subject: Vendr portal — evidence archive request and SLO implications
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: vendor-ops@vendr.com, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr portal — evidence archive request and SLO implications

Hi Vendr team,

Quick ask from our side: BrightLeaf (customer) has requested historical evidence exports beyond the standard 90-day staging window in the Vendr portal. They want a three-month export to be archived into their secure bucket (they provided a signed export consent). Before we proceed I need confirmation on two things from you: 

1) Export cadence & formats: can Vendr run a one-off full export (CAIQ + SIG mapping + raw evidence attachments) in a single job and deliver a CSV manifest + ZIP of artifacts?
2) Integrity and SLO impact: will running a large export spike affect our profiling SLOs (90th p90 latency for evidence retrieval) for other tenants in the same pool? If so, can we schedule during a low-impact window or route to a dedicated worker?

I attached a quick index of the evidence we expect to pull (evidence-index.csv) and a draft mapping that ties each evidence type to our SLO classification (slo-evidence-mapping.xlsx).

We'd like to move forward today if possible — BrightLeaf's security team is waiting for the archival receipt. Can you confirm scope and a target ETA?

Thanks,

Logan Wright
Security Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference
[attachment: evidence-index.csv (2KB)] [attachment: slo-evidence-mapping.xlsx (18KB)]

From: vendor-ops@vendr.com
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 10:03:15 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr portal — evidence archive request and SLO implications

Hi Logan — thanks for the clear outline and the attachments. Ticket #84723 created for tracking. Short answers up front: yes, we can do a one-off export with CAIQ + SIG mapping and a CSV manifest; and no, the export itself can be routed to our export cluster so it won't affect the primary portal SLOs if scheduled outside peak hours.

Couple of clarifying items before we schedule the job:
- What file-level retention / encryption scheme should be applied in the destination bucket (we support AES256 server-side; customers can provide KMS key if they need).
- Are attachments expected to include binary artifacts (signed reports, screenshots) or only documents (PDF/DOCX)? Large binaries increase job time.
- Please confirm the earliest acceptable export window — we have windows at 02:00–06:00 UTC and 18:00–22:00 UTC that are low-impact for your region.

We'll prepare a preflight job plan and a checksum manifest so you have an auditable receipt on completion.

Regards,
Vendr Operations
[Vendr export job stub created: vendr-export-84723]
[attachment: vendr-export-plan.txt (1KB)]

Thanks Vendr — that flow works. A few internal notes / asks that I added inline below (keeping your original text for context):

> Couple of clarifying items before we schedule the job:
> - What file-level retention / encryption scheme should be applied in the destination bucket (we support AES256 server-side; customers can provide KMS key if they need).

We will request BrightLeaf to provide a KMS key — requirement from their security team. If Vendr cannot accept a customer-managed KMS, we need confirmation.

> - Are attachments expected to include binary artifacts (signed reports, screenshots) or only documents (PDF/DOCX)? Large binaries increase job time.

Expect both PDFs and signed binary reports (.p7s). Please include a byte-size cap per file if you have one; if not, please document expected runtime.

> - Please confirm the earliest acceptable export window — we have windows at 02:00–06:00 UTC and 18:00–22:00 UTC that are low-impact for your region.

Prefer the 02:00–06:00 UTC window on Saturday 2027-06-26 (our timezone alignment). That should have zero impact on BrightLeaf's production users.

Action items from our side:
- Logan: confirm the destination bucket info and attach the signed export consent (will send after this thread).
- Lauren: please validate the mapping in slo-evidence-mapping.xlsx and flag any CAIQ-SIG mismatches.

Ben
Director, Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference

Vendr / team — thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirming final details so we can close this out: 

- Destination: gs://brightleaf-evidence-archives (BrightLeaf will supply a KMS key; BrightLeaf security copied).
- Export window: Saturday 2027-06-26, 02:30 UTC start (falls within your 02:00–06:00 UTC low-impact slot).
- Expected artifacts: CSV manifest, CAIQ JSON export, SIG spreadsheet, ZIP of attachments (PDF, .p7s).
- Post-run: please publish a checksum manifest and a signed job receipt (DocuSign stub acceptable).

Vendr, please confirm you can accept customer-managed KMS for the destination bucket and that export job vendr-export-84723 is scheduled for the requested window. Once confirmed we'll share the signed consent and the final bucket ARN.

Thanks everyone — Lauren, if you spot any mapping gaps in the spreadsheet let us know ASAP.
